title: Screensaver shows bottom bar in Android 9.0
body: I love the screensaver be functions as well as the lock screen function however the screensaver bugs me as it keeps the very bright bottom bar which also slows down charging... See the photos and OS details too... It's only small but holds me back from using it 24/7/365... Thanks in anticipation

Hi @Navid200 , sorry I've moved to a new phone now and unable to reproduce it on this phone. With the S9+ however I can confirm that I had done a factory reset to try and resolve the issue. One thing however that I've just thought about is the Day/Night Light/Dark mode setting. As this was brought in as an optional software update part way through owning the S9+ and I had it set to day mode rather than night, its possible that in night mode this would have been dark (or darker at least).

You could try reproduce this by turning off night auto mode on the android device and turning it to day mode only

Hope this helps

Henry
@haspden Is/was the navigation bar also visible if you click on preview in the screensaver settings?

Thanks for feedback.

I don't think the Android control panel characteristics are a part of xDrip.  I suspect this should be addressed by adjusting the behavior of the phone rather than the behavior of xDrip.

This issue can be found in searches even when it is closed.
If others experience this issue, we can always reopen.
